## How to create a new post

1. Copy this folder: `posts/hello-world/` → `posts/my-new-post/`
2. Edit `index.qmd` — update title, date, description, categories
3. Replace `thumb.png` with your own thumbnail
4. Write your content below the front matter

---

## Inserting images

```markdown
![Caption](image.png)
![Caption with lightbox](image.png){.lightbox}
```

## Inserting links

```markdown
[External link](https://example.com)
[Another post](../other-post/)
```
